title: Closeout summary: Phase 01B - Core directive schema and shared exports
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Closed Phase 01B after all child work completed. S01T04 added core AgentDirective types and exports, S01T05 added safe directive bundle/data validation helpers, and S01T06 added the published directive bundle schema plus import/export carrier validation. The phase acceptance is covered by child commits e7f23b7, 7b2aa59, and b5918f0 and by the post-closeout green sync/doctor state.

Close reason: All Phase 01B children closed and acceptance criteria verified by child evidence
